description: Search The Valley Desk directory of research software, publications and clinical studies connected to the nine-county Delaware Valley (Philadelphia region). Matches titles, topics, institutions and keywords. Every filter is optional. Returns up to 24 records per page with the site URL, the Verified or Listed evidence label and labelled dates.

added_from.description: Earliest date added to the directory. YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

added_to.description: Latest date added to the directory. YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

county.description: One of the nine Delaware Valley counties.

date_from.description: Earliest publication, last code push or study registry update date. YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

date_to.description: Latest published date or last code push. YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

institution.description: Institution name or id, for example "Drexel University". list_institutions returns the names.

kind.description: Limit to software projects, publications, clinical studies or datasets.

label.description: Limit to one regional evidence label.

page.description: Page number. Each page holds up to 24 records.

query.description: Words to match, for example "sepsis prediction".

sort.description: added: newest directory additions first (default). date: newest published or pushed first. title: A to Z.

topic.description: Topic name, for example "Medical imaging". list_topics_and_counties returns the names.

name: search

browse_url.description: The same search on the site.

access.description: For a dataset: Open, Registration or Controlled.

connection.description: The observed regional connection, as recorded.

dates.description: published: when a paper appeared. pushed: when project code last changed. last_updated: when the registry last updated a study. released: when a repository released a dataset. added: when the record entered the directory.

id.description: Directory id. Pass it to fetch.

repository.description: For a dataset, the repository that holds it.

url.description: The Valley Desk page for this record. Cite this URL.

truncated.description: True when records were dropped to fit the response size cap.

title: Search the research directory
